name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner seeks a way to speak with an uncorrupted furbolg. Southeast of Mystral Lake, Krolg offers a rare glimpse of the surviving furbolgs’ resentment toward the night elves.

sections.title: A Guise of Fur and Claw
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner believes the late night elf meant to use Dartol’s restored Rod of Transformation to approach the furbolgs in disguise. Ashenvale’s woods have grown perilous, and madness spreads through the tribes, leaving no path to direct diplomacy. The rod gives you the shape of a furbolg, so you can try to pass their territorial rage and find someone willing to speak.

sections.title: The Exile's Bitterness
sections.body: Southeast of Mystral Lake, Krolg lives apart from his kin, untouched by Fel Moss. Believing you are one of his own, he speaks freely of his exile and sorrow. He does not see the night elves as allies or protectors. Instead, he blames their pride and old failures for the demonic taint ravaging his people.

faq.q: What does Dartol's Rod of Transformation do?
faq.answer: Dartol’s Rod of Transformation briefly changes its bearer into a furbolg. The disguise lets you approach uncorrupted furbolgs without provoking an immediate attack.

Krolg is an uncorrupted furbolg living in exile southeast of Mystral Lake. He escaped the Fel Moss that infected his kin and lives alone across a torch-lined stream, mourning his lost tribe and resenting the night elves.

faq.q: Why will Krolg attack if you don't use the rod?
aliases: why use the rod on krolg
faq.answer: Krolg fears and distrusts outsiders, especially night elves, whom he blames for his people’s downfall. Without the rod’s disguise, he sees you as an intruder and attacks to defend his camp.

faq.q: Why does Krolg blame the night elves for the corruption?
aliases: why does krolg hate night elves
faq.answer: Krolg blames night elven pride for the demonic corruption ravaging the forest. He sees the ancient Kaldorei’s arcane meddling as bringing ruin to Kalimdor and leaving its indigenous tribes to suffer.
Krolg lives southeast of Mystral Lake in Ashenvale. A winding dirt path marked by burning torches crosses a small stream and leads to his solitary camp.

faq.q: What is Fel Moss and how did it affect the furbolgs?
faq.answer: Fel Moss is a demonic growth spreading through Ashenvale, tainting the soil and plants. Its influence drove local furbolg tribes into violent madness and fractured their society.

angles.text: For a night elf, Krolg’s words show that many of Ashenvale’s native inhabitants see the Kaldorei as reckless bringers of the land’s recurring ruin, not its guardians.
For a druid, the furbolgs’ plight is a stark sorrow: once close allies of nature, they now suffer terrible madness from lingering demonic taint.
For the Alliance, Astranaar’s survival depends on uncovering the dangers along the border roads. This secret meeting can help secure eastern Ashenvale.
